decisions.text: No WebView; a link to a Studio-only page opens the system browser through the foundation's web-link mapping ('Manage in Studio').

The Command Centre is ONE set of screens (Board, Calendar, Questions, Deliverables, sheets) built from tokens and the foundation's primitives, so A5 can dress them for Play (6/8/10/14 radii, serif display) and HUD (square panels, brackets, glyph plus WORD) without copying a screen: no style decision is hard-coded in a screen.

Every status is a filter, including Failed and Cancelled (closed folds into Cancelled as on the web); the server's needs-you number is the one number on the Command Centre button and the lede; the ticket sheet has Approve, Send back (a note is required) and Ask Auto about (the ticket as chat context, then 'Update ticket and re-queue' — the chat wave renders it).

Pause/Resume only for routines (PATCH /api/heartbeat/{agent_id}/toggle) and agent-scheduled tasks (PATCH /api/v1/scheduled-tasks/{id}/status); every other kind shows 'Manage in Studio'. Paused items are greyed and keep a word.
Answer with an option or in your own words; Dismiss (= deny) says that a stopped run's question closes its run; viewers read the question with the reason they cannot answer.

A social post awaiting approval opens from the needs strip (the chat wave's home links to routes.cc.social(postId)): the post as it will publish; Approve sends the content_hash of the exact version shown; Request changes needs a comment; never from a notification.

A gallery like Studio: filter by type, load more, open; text and images inline, PDF/DOCX/XLSX in the system viewer after an authenticated download. NO review state, NO Approve/Request changes, NO Awaiting/Done pills, NO 'DLV-' ids.

Live updates come from the foundation's ONE tasks/stream connection (board_changed invalidates board, ticket, needs-you and questions centrally; it refetches on resume). This wave opens no second connection and only reads useLiveStatus() for 'STREAMING LIVE'.

Owners, admins and editors approve, send back, answer, pause and approve social posts; viewers read only (src/auth/role.ts roleCan). Server 403s before PRD-266 W1 (questions are owner/admin only today) render the taxonomy's forbidden copy.
Writes (answer, approve, pause) are never queued offline; the server's compare-and-swap answer is the truth (409 'already answered' shows its words).
Nothing about plans, credits or prices.
All HTTP through the foundation's client; zod at every boundary; unknown fields ignored.

Files 200-400 lines (never over 800), functions under 50, components under 150, nesting under 4; pure logic in plain TS with tests; immutability; tokens only (the vendored calendar-kinds colours count as tokens, K14); every colour status has a word; 11 pt minimum.

No dependency, native module, config plugin or app.json change (package.json, package-lock.json, app.json, eas.json untouched — gate-enforced). The document viewer module was installed by the foundation (docs/native-modules.md names it).

This kit may create or change ONLY: src/cc/**, app/(app)/cc/** (replacing the foundation's placeholders), and its own kit files under scripts/ralph/. Everything else — src/api, src/auth, src/core, src/styles, src/ui, src/navigation, src/storage, app/_layout.tsx, app/(app)/_layout.tsx, app/(app)/index.tsx, app/(app)/chat/**, app/(app)/chats.tsx, app/(app)/settings/**, src/chat/**, package.json, app.json, .github — belongs to the foundation or the A2 kit (gate-enforced allowlist).

The foundation's contracts are fixed for this wave. If one is missing or wrong, build the smallest adapter under src/cc/ and write 'FOUNDATION GAP: <what, where>' in the DONE mark; never edit a foundation file. A missing UI primitive is built feature-local under src/cc/components/.

Every server path this wave calls is a constant in src/cc/routes.ts (the route check reads it). App routes are the foundation's builders; this wave creates the screen files they point at: app/(app)/cc/{board,calendar,questions,deliverables}.tsx, app/(app)/cc/ticket/[taskId].tsx, app/(app)/cc/social/[postId].tsx, app/(app)/cc/deliverable/[id].tsx — matching src/navigation/routes.ts exactly (read it; if a builder's path differs, follow the builder).
